english_classification.chapter_note: Heavily lacunose chapter preserving a substrate teaching about the progressive differentiation of the dark pentad: five elements → five worlds → five trees/fruits → five creations of flesh → ten parts (male/female) → twelve parts (adding fire and lust) mapped to the twelve zodiac signs. The enumeration structure ('first part'... 'fourth part'... 'fifth time') is the skeleton of the teaching, though gaps make reconstruction difficult. Editorial fatigue is textbook: substrate dominates ¶2-7, then ¶8-9 apply the twelve-part mapping to 'the holy church' and 'the twelve sects,' and ¶10 closes with devotional formula. The substrate teaching is the oldest layer and is dominant in this chapter despite the lacunae.
